rollback.note: 2.0.2 has the hidden confirmation bug; 2.0.1 has it too (introduced with the tutorial parity change). 2.0.0 predates it.

changes: The final 確認設定/開始訓練 panel is painted above the training screen again. Since 2.0.1 the tutorial runs on the real, inert .hart-page (z-index 1000); game.css set the panel to z-index 1200 with .hart-tutorial-ready, but rules.css loads later and its .training-panel z-index 900 has the same specificity, so the panel sat under the training screen

Players saw an unusable training screen: clicks passed through the inert layer to the hidden panel, so training never started and never went fullscreen (reported in Brave on Windows; other games were unaffected)
The rule is now .training-panel.hart-tutorial-ready, so source order cannot override it
Gameplay, settings, scoring and the five summary values are unchanged

platformDeploy.note: The push redeployed the Hub and runner Workers because test scripts changed; their source did not change and no new capability is needed.

failingFirst: scripts/check-hart-chart-tutorial.test.mjs 'the final confirmation is painted above the inert training scene': failed with confirmation z-index 900 vs training scene 1000

scripts/r2-game-ui-browser.mjs CheckConfirmationPresentation: lifts inert for one synchronous probe and requires the confirmation buttons on top; failed against production 2.0.2 (node scripts/check-r2-game-browser.mjs --game hart-chart --lobby --production-hub) with ['開始訓練', '返回設定'] hidden
tdd.whyMissedBefore: The browser fixture tapped the start button by coordinates; hit testing skips inert elements, so the tap reached the hidden button and the flow passed while the player could not see it
tdd.noFalsePositive: The shared check passed on production reading-training 2.0.2
